issues: Document has 461 pages, none rotated (all pages upright landscape A4; no rotation re-rendering was needed). The 'Область аккредитации' table has no ТР ТС / раздел section headings anywhere in the document, so tr_section is null on every row (per the schema rule of not substituting other heading-looking text). Items 1-79 (through ~page 404) each carry very long OKPD2/ТН ВЭД code lists (up to hundreds of codes spanning up to ~40 pages per item); items 80-404 are far denser, with many short numbered items per page. For pages ~413-437 (items covering СИЗОД/respiratory-protection standards: ГОСТ EN 1827, EN 12942, EN 13274, ГОСТ 12.4.121/12.4.166/12.4.234/12.4.235/12.4.236/12.4.244/12.4.245/12.4.246/12.4.285/12.4.293/12.4.296, EN 404/12083/14594, ГОСТ Р 12.4.294, ГОСТ Р 22.9.20, ГОСТ 12.4.082, СТБ 11.14.05, ГОСТ Р 12.4.253/12.4.272/12.4.300/12.4.238/12.4.075/12.4.023) and for pages ~439-450 (items 367-403: corrosion-test items, fall-protection/descent-device items, and most radioactive/chemical-PPE items before the final item), the scanned table's OKPD2/ТН ВЭД code columns are severely interleaved/wrapped across many overflow lines shared with neighboring numbered rows. Rather than risk mis-attributing a code to the wrong indicator row, okpd2_code and tnved_code were deliberately left null for the rows in those ranges (norm_doc/object/indicator/range text itself was transcribed with high confidence). Item 404 (the final item, whose own clean ТН ВЭД code block runs from page 451 to the end of the document at page 461) had its ~319 codes extracted directly and attached to that row. A recurring OCR/print artifact resembling a stray fragment of code '6403 59 990 0' (split as '6403 4.4.068' / '3 59 990 0') appears at a similar relative position on many pages within items 1-79's page ranges; it was treated as noise and not included as a separate spurious code. No illegible/undecipherable table cells were encountered that required a '[неразборчиво]' marker. Downstream consumers needing exact OKPD2/ТН ВЭД codes for the SIZOD range (~pages 413-437) or items 367-403 (~pages 439-450) should cross-check against the source PDF pages directly.
